desc:
🎤 Grow A KPOP IDOL — go from nameless trainee to K-POP superstar!

🏙️ NEW! SEASON 2: LABEL WARS
HYPE, YJ, LSM and JYB battle every week! Your debuts, concerts and albums grow your agency's tower. Paint the plaza for your label and lead it to #1!

🎬 NEW! CUSTOMIZE YOUR CONCERT
In EDIT STAGE, place group dances, killing parts and FX right on the beat. Or just tap START SHOW for a ready-made stage!
🤖 AUTO STAGE: hit every beat automatically, switch it on/off anytime.

🔺 TRAIN — vocal, dance, rap & visual. Grade F to S!
🏢 SIGN — reach grade A and join HYPE, YJ, LSM or JYB!
🌟 DEBUT — tour from live houses to stadiums.
👯 MAKE A GROUP — gather your idols, pick a center, name your group.
🎆 GROUP CONCERTS — perfect formations and signature ending poses!

💄 GLOW — hair, makeup and your own idol face
👗 IDOL STYLE boutique · 🏠 dorms, fansigns, photocards

👯 Debut with your friends!
🎁 Code: THANKS10K · ⭐ Favorite to unlock the next code!
